content.text:
**Finding: LICENSE — compliant (preferred).**

The grant clauses meet every preferred element:

| Element | Source |
|---|---|
| Affiliates | §13.1 / §13.2 ("Customer, its Affiliates") |
| Contractors acting on Customer's behalf | §13.1 ("contractors acting on their behalf") |
| Paid-up perpetual | §13.2 ("perpetual") |
| Paid-up irrevocable | §13.2 ("irrevocable") |
| Subscription terminable only for uncured material breach | §13.3 (no revocation/suspension except material uncured breach after notice and cure opportunity) |
| Transferable to successors | §13.3, supported by §24.1 (no-consent assignment to successor in merger/acquisition) |

No redline proposed. Two points noted in the rationale rather than flagged: the control-based "Affiliate" definition is adequate, and §14.2's "revocable, non-transferable" Deliverable licence conflicts with §§13.2–13.3 but is the same commercial term addressed under the IP rule, so it is not flagged twice here.
